result.description:
Metal Fabricator
Company: SEC Business Group
Location: DRY CREEK SA 5094
Salary: AUD 80,000 - 90,000 per annum (depending on experience)
Employment Type: Full-time

About SEC Business Group
SEC Business Group Pty Ltd is an established engineering, fabrication, and industrial services company
based in Adelaide, South Australia. We specialise in conveyor systems, mechanical engineering, fabrication, and project services

About the Role
Our client, SEC Business Group, is seeking a skilled Metal Fabricator to join their team in Adelaide, South Australia. In this role, you will be responsible for fabricating, assembling, repairing, and maintaining metal components and structures in workshop
operations.

Key Responsibilities
Fabricate, assemble, and weld metal parts and structures based on technical drawings and specifications
Repair and modify agricultural machinery, plant equipment, and structural components
Perform welding, cutting, grinding, shaping, and finishing of metal materials 
Interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and fabrication plans
Carry out maintenance and repair work on machinery and workshop equipment
Assist in installation and fitting of new equipment and machinery upgrades
Inspect completed work to ensure compliance with quality and safety standards
Support preventative maintenance activities across farm and workshop operations
Maintain tools, equipment, and fabrication workspace in safe working condition
Collaborate with mechanics, technicians, and farm operations staff

Requirements
Trade qualification in Metal Fabrication, Boilermaking, or equivalent
Proven experience in fabrication, welding, or metalwork in industrial or agricultural settings
Strong welding skills (MIG, TIG, and/or ARC preferred)
Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications
Good understanding of workplace health and safety standards
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Physically fit and able to work in a hands-on environment


What We Offer
Competitive salary package
Stable full-time role in a growing agricultural operation
Hands-on and varied workshop environment
Opportunities for skills development and training
Supportive and safety-focused team culture
Long-term career stability in the agricultural sector
